input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) covers only loss of access, Deliverable delivery and refunds. It references "any agreed transition period" but creates no obligation on Vendor to provide transition assistance, and nothing anywhere in the Agreement requires return or export of Customer Data in a usable format or certified deletion. Section 16.5 expressly carves Customer Data out of the return/destroy duty and defers to "Sections 11 and 15" — Section 11 does not exist in the document, and Section 15 addresses processing and privacy only, not exit. The Agreement therefore fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days), leaving our data with no guaranteed retrieval path. Inserted a new Section 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (subject to routine backup/legal retention, consistent with Section 16.5).

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to our data back or to migration help on termination (Section 16.5 even cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). This reflects our standard position: up to six months' transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that suits your delivery model better.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
